scope: Minimal studio-reply outcome correction; not a claim that every usability finding is resolved.

behavior.legacyDiscussionReplies: Readable and unresolved; no rewrite of historical data.
behavior.offlineNotifications: None; the friend is told the studio sees a question only when it next opens Rally.
behavior.aiClaim: Application privacy checks apply to both manual and AI-drafted questions; no anonymity guarantee.

verification.regression: Unsupported discussion reply was accepted before the fix; the rejection test then passed.

packaging.privateJudgeHandoff: Optional step added before the original Sam flow, preserving all other content.
packaging.devpost: Factual paragraph prepared outside source control for the owner to paste. No Devpost edit performed.

limits: No new hosted authenticated relay walkthrough or independent friend/studio observation.
The studio still receives no offline question notification.
This patch does not add threaded follow-up or change the existing question-per-revision rule.
